meta.title: OrbNote 3.0 — Capture First. Organize Later.
meta.description: OrbNote is a conversational inbox for Apple users. Capture text, photos, voice, files, and checklists as messages, then organize them when it helps.

hero.title: Capture first. Organize later.
hero.description: OrbNote is a conversational notebook and personal inbox for Apple users. Capture text, photos, voice, files, and small tasks as naturally as sending a message.

privacy.title: Personal memory should stay personal
privacy.description: OrbNote is local-first and uses your own iCloud account for synchronization. Sensitive Threads can be protected with a password, while AI features remain optional and clearly separated from ordinary capture.

privacy-e2ee.title: Still deeply integrated with Apple CloudKit and E2EE
privacy-e2ee.description: For regular notes and syncing, OrbNote continues to rely on Apple CloudKit and Advanced Data Protection. When enabled, your content can be protected with end-to-end encryption in transit and at rest.

links.text: Learn about iCloud Advanced Data Protection

features-intro.title: One inbox for everything you have not organized yet
features-intro.description: Save the thought immediately, keep its context, and add structure only when structure starts helping you remember.

quick-jot.title: Catch the idea before the filing decision interrupts it
quick-jot.description: Quick Jot is a built-in inbox for thoughts and drafts. Start with one sentence, then add a photo, recording, file, or checklist in the same timeline.

ai-organization.title: You capture it. AI suggests where it belongs.
ai-organization.description: After capture, AI Organization can recommend a suitable Thread and explain why. You can accept the suggestion, ignore it, or let OrbNote handle it automatically when you choose that option in settings.

capabilities.title: Not just text—and not just title search
capabilities.description: Keep different kinds of context together, then search messages, attachments, OCR text, recordings, and imported reading content.

rich-content.title: Rich content in one history
rich-content.description: Text, photos, files, voice, and checklists stay close to the idea that connects them.

search.title: Search that explains the match
search.description: Find the exact message or attachment and understand whether text, OCR, audio, or an imported article matched.

privacy-lock.title: Add another boundary around important Threads
privacy-lock.description: Protect selected Threads with a password when a device-level lock is not enough for the material you keep.

connected.title: Capture where the idea happens. Continue where it is comfortable.
connected.description: Use your own iCloud account to stay up to date, and start a recording from Apple Watch when your phone or Mac is not nearby.

icloud.title: Your iCloud, your synchronized notes
icloud.description: Keep the same conversational notebook available across iPhone, Mac, and iPad.

watch.title: Start on your wrist
watch.description: Capture a voice thought on Apple Watch, then continue organizing it on a larger device.

ai-workflow.title: You send the content, AI makes a suggestion, and your setting decides what happens next
ai-workflow.description: Whether it is a short sentence, a screenshot, an attachment, or voice input, OrbNote uses limited context to suggest the right group, Thread, title, and body. Review it first, ignore it, or enable your chosen automatic option.

showcase.title: The point of AI Save is not chat
showcase.description: It turns scattered inputs into structured notes you can keep building on. The examples below mix real product screenshots with feature visuals from the current version.

capture.title: Bring multiple inputs into one flow
capture.description: Text, images, attachments, and voice can all enter the same AI Save flow instead of being split into disconnected actions.

structure.title: Generate a save suggestion
structure.description: AI suggests the right group, the right thread, and a cleaner title and body so you spend less time manually organizing.

longtext.title: There is an AI gateway, but no user content backend
longtext.description: When you actively use AI Save, your request briefly passes through OrbNote's stateless AI gateway for authentication, rate limiting, routing, and result forwarding. We do not persist the content you send to AI in our own database, and we do not record plaintext content in routine service logs.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
body: Q: Do I need to organize every message immediately?
A: No. Quick Jot is designed for capture first. Move messages into Threads when the destination becomes useful or leave them in the inbox until a pattern appears.
A: No. You can always organize manually. AI Organization is an optional OrbNote Pro feature that suggests a suitable Thread after capture.
Q: Where are my ordinary notes stored?
A: OrbNote is local-first and uses your own iCloud account for synchronization across Apple devices.
Q: Can OrbNote keep more than text?
A: Yes. A conversation can include supported photos, voice recordings, files, and checklists alongside text.

download.description: Capture the next thought as a message. Add structure later, when it starts helping you remember.
